countries.system: Historic Counties Standard, Definition A; detached parts assigned to host county. Cultural/historical geography, NOT current administrative counties.

limitations: Definition A was selected as an explicit proposed implementation choice. Definition B associates detached areas with their parent historic county and is a separate alternative.

Downloaded WGS84 simplified KML converted to GeoJSON; additionally simplified at 0.001 degree tolerance for display. Not suitable for precision boundary decisions.
Yorkshire is one county; its Ridings and the Parts of Lincolnshire are not separately counted. Northern Ireland remains in geographic scope although excluded from the requested football layer.
